channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Presley Gerber's death investigated as overdose, police say
item.description: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, died Sunday at a rehab facility. He was 27.

item.title: Equipment outage causes hundreds of flight cancellations
item.description: Flights are halted at Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey and Philadelphia International Airport in Pennsylvania due to an equipment issue.

item.title: Advocates seek independent inquiry after ICE agent shoots Venezuelan DoorDash driver in Texas
item.description: Civil rights attorneys and community leaders spoke Monday after a Venezuelan DoorDash driver was shot and wounded by an ICE agent in Austin, Texas.

item.title: Beshear tells 'The View' he remains concerned about McConnell's ability to serve
item.description: Gov. Andy Beshear told ABC's 'The View' on Monday that he still has concerns about Sen. Mitch McConnell's ability to serve after returning from a June hospital stay.
